name: drape-background

frames.best_why: The curtain is fully lit with clear vertical pleats and long soft folds at the base, headline still readable.

tagline: A dark pleated curtain ripples and parts when the cursor pushes it.
summary: A full-bleed simulated fabric backdrop in charcoal tones, hanging in soft vertical pleats with white copy centred over it. It sways in a slow breeze and can be pushed, grabbed and pulled aside.
appearance: The frame is filled by dark cloth in even vertical pleats, its crests catching faint grey light while valleys fall to black. Centred over it are a white headline, a tiny spaced-out eyebrow and one line of grey copy.
behaviour: The curtain hangs and sways under a slow breeze, its lower folds drifting in long curves and settling again. Moving the pointer presses the fabric and drags it along; pressing grabs the nearest fold so it can be pulled aside.
demo_content: "Behind the curtain" headline, "Autumn / Winter 2026" eyebrow and a one-line caption.
search_phrases: fabric that moves with the mouse
soft black drape for a hero
use_when: An atmospheric full-bleed backdrop for fashion, launch or editorial pages where copy sits over texture.
avoid_when: It is built for dark themes, and the full-screen fabric simulation keeps the CPU busy while it moves.
customise: Pass any content as children to layer over the cloth, or null for a bare backdrop. Wind strength, pleat depth and pointer interaction are props; the cloth colours follow the page theme.
weight_why: A CPU cloth simulation relaxes thousands of links every frame before each WebGL draw.

a11y.note: The canvas is hidden from assistive tech; reduced motion removes the breeze and the push and grab handlers.

issues: The small caption under the headline is very dim against the dark cloth.
polish_why: Convincing cloth motion and light on the folds; the small copy is too faint to read.
